If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. findings.problem: Home page and product pages have a newsletter promotion link at the very top and a very long page of links before the main content; no skip link or main landmark was announced

findings.page: Radiant Reflection Cap | Fashion Web Store
findings.problem: Product page shows five disabled unlabeled radio buttons (rating stars) with no name, confusing to hear

findings.page: Your shopping cart | Fashion Web Store
findings.problem: After adding to cart, the page changed to the cart with only a success alert; also an unlabeled icon-only button (remove item) and an unlabeled quantity spinbutton in the cart table, and a hidden-looking mini cart repeated at the end of the page
Field labels were first exposed without required markers, then changed to asterisk names after load, so the exact names I tried (Email) were not found; asterisk in every required name is noisy
Choosing United States silently added a new Province field with no announcement; I only found it by tabbing, and it is not marked required or explained

The signed-in email link was announced as [email protected] (obfuscated) and the checkout step indicator is not clearly marked as current step; PayPal radio is preselected without announcement of what Next will do
